reviews.text:
I really like the Juno Vet team.

The clinic itself is really nice, and I love the way the rooms are set up for to unwind your pet. Outside of the privacy, the rooms have feliway diffusers!

They've all been extremely kind, informative, gentle, and accomodating to me when it comes to pickup/medications/scheduling (I don't have a car, live a bit of a trek from them and one of my cats gets very very carsick so travel to them has been a headache). All the good stuff you hope when you leave your pet in someone else's care.

When it comes to pricing they strike me as a very pricey compared to when I lived in Burnaby/Surrey so if you're new to Vancouver pet ownership you may be a bit gobsmacked like I was when I moved back here, BUT in comparison to a couple vets in the area their pricing was directly comparable and in Juno's case I feel I am getting more for my money. They keep in solid contact checking up throughout healing at home, sending pictures of your pet in their care, hell they'll make you a coffee when you arrive. I never once left uncertain or in the dark about what was happening, they answer questions swiftly  and fully. There's a warmth and familiarity to their correspondance, they have great customer face lol. There was also an instance where an extra procedure had to occur for Reina that I honestly would have fought for a discount... but I didn't need to. Unspoken they must have reached the same conclusion about the aftercare instructions and adjusted the pricing. That was the ultimate green flag for them for me. I feel like I'm getting what I paid for whereas at another vet I tried in the area I felt very much ripped off.

Took my duck-tolling retriever here in early July and had a really poor experience. I went because I needed a new vet after a move, and they had the $100 promo on. They were quite late to see us, when they did, he needed blood drawn and vaccines.  Vaccines are easy, but the blood draw was terrible. The vet tech started to freak out when she couldn't find a vein, and when she did, she punctured it; blood went everywhere (they had to clean it with a towel and tried to hide it from me). Even for doing the vaccines and blood draw, they gave him two full plates of peanut butter and treats...excessive. They also suggested that we switch food, and this is the biggest reason for me leaving a review now - he has gained an unhealthy amount of weight, going from grain-free his whole life to grain food. I also ended up having to take him back a second time for MORE blood to be taken for his results. I would not recommend this place. Giving two stars because they still followed up and did do the service I paid for.

Dr. Sarah Zelinski is such an excellent Vet. My cat Grace is so comfortable at Juno as everyone is so kind and warm, thoughtful and thorough. I felt they did everything possible to help me with the issue. My darling girl is doing so much better already thanks to the care and services of Juno Vet.

Best experience I've ever had at the vet!!! My dog struggles with severe anxiety and the vet is a major trigger but we walked in to an immediately calming environment and everyone was so kind and friendly and my doggy got so spoiled with lots of treats. In the past I would gear myself up to have a stressful time at the vet but thanks to Juno I learned today that it doesn't have to be like that!!! Also the treat bar is such a good idea ❤️

I don’t usually leave negative reviews, especially when the staff and veterinarian were so kind during the actual appointment.. However, I am extremely disappointed and frustrated with the lack of follow-through and professionalism after visiting Juno vet for the first time.

I brought my rescue dog in for her first check-up since coming home -  and clearly noted that she was overweight. I was seeking a structured weight loss plan + any nutrition notes. This was discussed during the appointment, and I was explicitly told  by the vet that a feeding/weight management plan would be included in the discharge paperwork.

That did not happen.

When I received the discharge documents, there was no weight loss plan included. I called in to follow up and they said it would come shortly. I provided all relevant information; including her current food, medical history, and bloodwork. Despite following up multiple times over the course of four days, I received no actual plan or clear update. I was only told the veterinarian would be back in office later in the week, which should have been communicated much earlier instead of leaving me waiting with no guidance..

When I finally did receive a response yesterday, it was a brief text message claiming to be my pet's “Feeding Plan.”

I felt insulted reading this plan. It was vague, generic, and did not reflect what was discussed during the appointment. I was told in person by the vet that my dog’s current intake of ~300 calories per day was too high, yet the "Feeding Plans" recommendation suggested feeding 81 grams of her current kibble—which calculates to roughly 320 calories.  This contradiction is unacceptable for what was supposed to be a structured medical feeding plan. On top of that, this "plan" didn't mention anything about target weight, daily calorie limit and treat allowances.. What was provided was incomplete and so generic it's something I could have determined myself from reading the food packaging. For a paid veterinary appointment, I am left so upset with this experience.  I immediately replied back to "Feeding Plan" text message expressing my concerns and they responded 21 hours later saying they had send me an email. I did not receive any email at all lol.. I've tried calling in multiple times as well and have never been able to get through.

My husband and I were looking for a reliable long-term veterinary clinic, but this experience has made it clear that this is not the right fit for us. Overall, what a terrible experience here.

Before my dog passed away, I went to Juno Vet Kitsilano to get my dog checked because she suddenly lost her appetite and she didn’t want to walk. They welcomed us warmly and get her checked out. They gave me suggestions either to put her down or get her a surgery but they have told me that she might not handle because she’s old. I didn’t listen to them as I wanted to keep my dog beside me until she pass away. I did see my dog suffer from the pain before she passed. I did regret that I might have made her more painful but i also don’t regret because she did stay with me and my partner for more than a week. Mix of feelings.. However, I was busy with so many things that I haven’t checked my mailbox and today I found that they have sent me a letter. This is really thoughtful, made me cry again 😭. I do really miss my dog, wish she would visit me in my dream. Thank you again Juno Vet, even though we have met once. Thank you for being so gentle with my dog when getting her checked and giving her antibiotics! I want to tell my dog that everybody is missing her and she’s always loved ❤️. Thank you, I really appreciate your letter 🙂.

If you're thinking about changing your vet clinic to Juno because a private equity firm bought out your old clinic and the service went to sh&t, make the change.  You won't regret it.  They back up the beautiful paint colours and complimentary bubbly water with a genuinely great vet experience.

I've unfortunately had to bring my cat in four times in the last six months and both me and my cat have been treated so well by all members of the staff at the Kits and Main Street locations.  The vets are honest, compassionate, and communicate clearly without being condescending. Support staff are kind and competent (a dream duo!). Pricing is up front, transparent, and reasonable.  A payment plan service was made available to me for more costly treatments, and there weren't any predatory financing fees or interest rates. There's a service through their app that gives you 24/7 access to a vet tech in a chat so if you've got a barfing cat at 1 am,  you can chat with a real life non-AI human being about it and they won't make you feel stupid for doing so. Most importantly though, my cat just came home from a treatment smelling of someone else's perfume because he'd been getting cuddles while coming out of sedation, which is what prompted me to write this review. Many thanks to everyone at Juno, please keep up the great work.

Rachael, thank you so much for the 5 stars, we really appreciate it! 
Please give Cora, Mona, Ollie, and Maxine some extra love from all of us 💚We’re always here if you need anything! 😸 …

I can't honestly say enough great things about this clinic. Juno is literally a dream vet clinic. The doctors are always so kind and gentle and the staff/assistants are also always so kind. I always feel like my pets are in good care here and I'm really happy I decided to try them out.
Amazing place and staff. My dog is calm and comfortable the entire visit
This people are so caring! Absolutely lovely experience for everyone. The vet was so calm and the staff explained everything.

We recently had to say goodbye to our beloved cat, and I can’t express how grateful we are for the care and compassion Juno's staff showed us during such a difficult time.

From the moment we arrived, they treated both us and our cat with incredible kindness, patience, and respect. The vet Esther took the time to explain everything clearly, never rushed us, and made sure our cat was as comfortable as possible.

What could have been an overwhelmingly painful experience was made so much more gentle and dignified because of her. We felt truly supported every step of the way.

Thank you, Esther, for your empathy and professionalism—it meant more to us than we can say. We will always remember the care you gave our cat in her final days.

New to the Vancouver area— found Juno on Google after (mistakenly) going to Beach Avenue Animal Hospital for my cat. WOW the difference in hospitality!! Couldn’t recommend this vet enough! The staff are lovely and personable with you and your pet! Prices are VERY fair and affordable compared to the other vets I’ve been to. 10/10

My dog Gael and I got the best experience at Juno in Kitsilano. The entire team is super friendly and professional and totally dedicated to both pet and owner's comfort. They went the extra mile to find ways so I could afford his treatment and were always available over text or phone. They also have an amazing app where I have access to all Gael's records.
What an incredible team! I had the chance to bring my dog to Juno and couldn't have asked for a better experience. I highly recommend the team.
Amazing! they take such good care of your pets. I’m so glad I found them.

I took my cat Boris to Juno Veterinary Clinic in Kitsilano for the first time today, and I had a great experience.

From the moment we arrived, the entire team was incredibly kind, welcoming, and professional. They treated Boris with so much care and patience, which made the visit much less stressful for both of us. The staff took the time to listen, answer my questions, and make sure Boris was comfortable throughout the appointment.

It’s clear that everyone there truly cares about the animals they treat. I’m very happy I chose this clinic and I’m grateful for the excellent care they provided.

Highly recommended!
Thank you so much for your 5-star review! We really appreciate your support and are thrilled to have you as part of the Juno community.
The staff were very friendly, we were able to immediately go and wait in a private room which was extremely clean. My cat got lots of treats and was very well taken care of. 10/10 experience !!!
Amazing first visit here. From the staff at the front desk to the vets, we had an amazing experience with our puppy. A clean, calm and loving environment!

I brought my cat here last weekend and was so impressed! The staff are awesome, the process and the pricing are very transparent, and the space is beautiful. I could tell that my little one liked it here (as much as a cat can like a vet!). I completely recommend checking Juno out.

I brought our cat here after years of going to another vet. Everyone is super friendly and professional (thank you for the coffee and the free treats, Nathalie!), and the costs were explained clearly. The doctor immediately identified some underlying issues that our previous vet had missed, and set us up with a long-term plan to resolve them after initial care. Thank you all so much for your careful treatment of Lousha!

We took our Maine Coon kitten Goose here for her first check up and to get some advice on future care. The staff at Juno vet made us feel welcomes and reassured. We ended up signing up for the Kitten wellness plan and feel very secure in the fact this is our vet moving forward. Highly recommend this place due to the friendly knowledgeable staff, clean and caring environment and complementary treats which Goose was thrilled about.

Juno is a clean, welcoming space! We took our kitten there and they handled us and her with so much care, and kindness.
The staff are great and very loving to your little ones, and also really help make everything as affordable as possible to your needs! We have another appointment in a few weeks! 🐈‍⬛

Our first visit to Juno was a resounding success! Winnie can be shy of new people and places, but the team was very welcoming and encouraging to make sure she felt comfortable, with plenty of treats and attention along the way. Dr. Sarah and the full team offer highly professional and thorough care, while balancing warmth and kindness with their patients. It was easy to share past medical records, set up and appointment online, and health information is also conveniently available through their app. Dr. Sarah took time to review my dog’s full medical history, offered professional advice, and transparency around testing options and pricing. Following Winnie’s checkup, I immediately received a full summary and details on next steps for care to ensure I was well prepared to monitor any home care needs following the appointment. After trying many veterinarians, we are so happy you have come to Kitsilano and we look forward to seeing you again!

Outstanding service! Staff were very kind and clear, specially Nathalie at the front desk. It felt like they really cared about our dog, they offered some treats for our him and they have a beverage station with some coffee, tea and sodas.

They also have an amazing app so you can access your pet records. It is intuitive, simple and has a beautiful user experience.

I’ll absolutely come back.

So happy to have Juno Veterinary in the neighbourhood! Their team is incredibly friendly, the space is beautiful, and I love how transparent they are with pricing and care plans. I’ve known the brand for a while and am genuinely excited to have them nearby for my cats.

Had a great first visit today! Everyone was so nice, kind and welcoming. Freya appreciated all the treats she got and it was a really nice introduction to Juno. Definetely the best vet clinic we’ve been to and glad to be a patient here
Fantastic clinic with exceptional service! Everyone was so kind and attentive — I’m so happy my cat and I found this place.

I can’t say enough wonderful things about Juno veterinary clinic! They’ve taken such amazing care of my two cats, Luna and Sunny. From the moment we walked in, we were greeted by Nathalia at the front desk — she is always so kind, patient, and welcoming. She goes above and beyond to make scheduling and visits stress-free, which means a lot when you have two curious cats in carriers!

The vets and techs are gentle, thorough, and clearly passionate about what they do. They take the time to explain everything, and I always feel confident that Luna and Sunny are getting the best possible care.

The clinic is clean, calm, and well-organized — you can tell they truly care about both pets and their people. I’m so grateful to have found a place where my cats are treated like family. Highly recommend!

I took my dog Bella to Juno Vet for her first visit, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience! From the moment we walked in, everyone was so kind and welcoming. Dr. Adam and Dr. Sarah were amazing, gentle, knowledgeable, and took the time to explain everything clearly. RVT Mischa and Assistant Erika were so sweet with Bella, and Nathalia and Ren at the front desk made us feel right at home.

Bella can sometimes be a bit nervous, but wasn’t afraid at all, she didn’t even cry when they did her blood work! She absolutely loved the treats and left the clinic happy and relaxed.

Thank you, Juno Vet, for taking such great care of Bella. We’re so grateful to have found such a compassionate and professional team! 🐾💛
Thank you so much, Yuji! We really appreciate the 5-star review and are so glad you and Hana had a positive experience with our team. It means a lot to us! 🐾 …
Thank you so much for your 5-star review! We really appreciate your support and are thrilled to have you as part of the Juno community.
Staff are dedicated, thorough, and very knowledgable! A great addition to the Kits neighborhood!
Their staff are top shelf!
Awesome new clinic! The space is very welcoming and the staff are amazing. Highly recommend paying them a visit!
What a great clinic. A nice new space. Very friendly and knowledgeable staff. The vet was great. I really felt that my dog was in the best care. Highly recommended this vet clinic.
Amazing staff who care so much about their work and patients (animals!).

Yesterday my fearful kitty, Cleo, was seen at Juno, and it was truly the best vet experience we’ve ever had. The team was so kind, patient, and understanding! they let Cleo set the pace and choose how she wanted to be handled. It was completely fear-free and so respectful of her comfort.

Dr. Esther, RTV Mischa, Erika, Nathalia, and Ren were all incredible!!! So gentle, attentive, and genuinely caring. For the first time ever, Cleo came home calm and relaxed after a vet visit, and that honestly means so much to me. I left feeling grateful, relieved, and really seen as a pet parent. I can’t thank them enough for making such a difference for both of us ❤️

The team was very good with her and helped advise me on the tests she needed as she's getting older.  The clinic experience reminds me of a boutique hotel!  Very chic and great medical professionals!
Thank you so much for your 5-star review! We really appreciate your support and are thrilled to have you as part of the Juno community.
